verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a public REST API (alongside an MCP server) that it says exposes 'the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app'. It markets the API for automated searches and custom workflows, and llms.txt documents at least one concrete parameter (excludePreprints=true). Missing for 10: a detailed API reference covering endpoints, authentication and rate limits; evidence that non-search features such as Library, Deep Search and Citation Graph are drivable via the API; independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
